properties.name: Green Brook sample area
properties.note: Position read off the Fig. 2 asterisk by graticule interpolation (the figure's scale bar and graticule disagree by ~8 %, so +/-300 m); shown as a zone, not a point. Fig. 2 draws the GBR asterisk at the south-western tip of a gabbroid (Jpg) lens; in the NJGWS DGS15-1 digital map the nearest Jpg polygon begins ~430 m to the north-east, i.e. Fig. 2 (modified from that map by the authors) extends the gabbroid lens farther south-west than the digital data do. The zone follows the paper.
